metadata.credentialUse: One owned-scoped-pat client and unchanged bearer value for every subsequent case.
metadata.acquisitionVariant: Existing CLI client/auth/gates/transport with a fixed capture-only setup: random password added only to the owned user creation and Basic used only to issue that same user's scoped PAT. Credential exchange entities are excluded. Captured policy cases use one normal unchanged client with that PAT. Installed/acceptance CLI and original acquisition remain unchanged.
limits: Owned-user current grants with explicit scoped PAT restrictions; not target OIDC/JWT or Agent/workload proof.
Private credential setup is deliberately not a literal conformance case; no secret entities/Authorization headers exported.

cohort_scope.scope: Exact selected property-access/current-role wire cases. No target OIDC/JWT, Agent/run workflow, whole AC or global operation-family acceptance.
cohort_scope.product_prerequisite: Real compatible projects and ordinary scoped credential/current-role services; unavailable in legacy target.
